text: Did your child stick with something difficult today, or give up quickly? What was it?
Was there a moment where your child chose to try again instead of walking away?
How did your child react when they got something wrong — embarrassed, curious, frustrated, or something else?
Did your child approach today's work with genuine effort or just enough to get by? What made you think so?
Was there a subject or task your child engaged with more deeply than usual? What do you think drew them in?
When your child got feedback or a lower mark than expected, how did they process it?
What emotion did your child show most today? Did they know what to call it?
Was there a moment your child felt overwhelmed? How did they handle it?
Did your child seem settled in themselves today, or was something quietly unsettling them?
Was your child able to name how they were feeling today, or did it come out sideways — as irritability, withdrawal, or restlessness?
Did your child have a moment of genuine calm or joy today, not from a screen? What was it?
Is there anything your child seemed to be carrying emotionally that they didn't talk about?
Did your child talk about a friend today? What did they say?
Was there a moment where your child showed kindness to someone — in the family or outside?
Did your child have a disagreement with anyone today? How did it go?
Did your child show empathy toward someone today — noticing how another person felt, not just what they needed?
How are your child's friendships feeling right now — easy, complicated, distant?
Was there a moment where your child chose someone else's needs over their own?
Did your child do something responsible today without being asked?
Was there a moment where your child was honest, even when it was uncomfortable?
Did your child show care for someone in the family today?
Was there a moment today where your child made a choice that reflected their values — even a small one?
Did your child take ownership of a mistake today, or deflect it?
Is there something your child did today that you'd want them to remember as an example of who they are?
How was your child's energy today — bouncy, flat, somewhere in between?
Did your child get any physical activity today? What was it?
How did your child sleep last night, and did it show today?
Is your child getting enough physical movement this week, or mostly sitting?
How is the balance between screens and everything else right now?
Did your child show signs of being physically worn out or genuinely well-rested today?
Did something go wrong for your child today? How long did it take them to bounce back?
Was there a moment your child surprised you with how they handled something hard?
Did your child give up on something today? What do you think was behind it?
How is your child responding to pressure right now — do they face it, avoid it, or shut down?
Was there a setback this week your child handled better than you expected?
Does your child believe they can get better at the things they struggle with, or do they treat those as fixed about themselves?
